original_sentence: Many see friendships as a comfort blanket: a shoulder to cry on, a reliable soul to confide in.
translation: 许多人把友谊看作一条安慰毯：一个可以依靠哭泣的肩膀，一个可以倾诉的可靠灵魂。

confide in 在本句中对应"向……倾诉"。
